title: Decentralized Learning with Dynamically Refined Edge Weights: A Data-Dependent Framework
summary: This paper aims to accelerate decentralized optimization by strategically designing the edge weights used in the agent-to-agent message exchanges. We propose a Dynamic Directed Decentralized Gradient (D3GD) framework and show that the proposed data-dependent framework is a practical alternative to the classical directed DGD (Di-DGD) algorithm for learning on directed graphs. To obtain a strategy for edge weights refinement, we derive a design function inspired by the cost-to-go function in a new convergence analysis for Di-DGD.
